api.metadata: Environment All; SecretArguments AllowedWhenUntainted; generated DeathRecapEventInfo field list empty; no recap-ready event declared

death_event.name: PLAYER_DEAD
death_event.recap_id_payload: No declared payload. Do not invent one.
death_event.callback: Capture death-notification identity/context; do not assume default recap changed by this point.

additional_v454_consumer_fields.destGUID: Used to filter local player; not typed in current generated API schema, so guarded optional evidence only.
additional_v454_consumer_fields.critical: Optional used by v454; no typed field promise.

freshness_release_gate: Default/nil recap is not automatically this death. Same destGUID only establishes player identity, not freshness.
Maintain bounded previously accepted explicit personal recap IDs/link tokens and public row fingerprints before death when available; baseline unknown stays unknown.

Strong candidate: query readable native meter personal death rows using NeverSecret isLocalPlayer/deathRecapID and explicit session identity; select a newly observed explicit ID associated with the current personal death window, not newest group death.

If using default current recap, require a new public ID/link token relative to a known baseline plus corroborating local destGUID when available and new public fingerprint; do not treat any one alone as universal proof.
No documented guaranteed GetTime alignment for recap timestamps; do not compare absolute recap timestamp to local death GetTime without validated clock relationship.
With no provable new personal association within3 attempts, render Current native recap unavailable; preserve prior page as explicitly previous, never relabel it current.

All consumed row/container/identity fields are checked public and correct type before branching/calculating/fingerprinting. Missing destination identity does not become player. Unknown amount/HP is not0.
Native rows cap16; if larger public table, mark truncated. Do not rank/sort unreadable fields. Keep native killing row identity before chronological UI reorder.
GetRecapMaxHealth is one recap value, not per-event max HP. currentHP pre/post-hit semantics not documented. No synthetic HP/heal curve from damage totals.
Three retries bound work but are not proof of availability; native data can remain absent, secret, stale or inaccessible.
ids_limit: A changed link/ID is useful corroboration, not a documented eternal/global uniqueness guarantee. Recap lifetime and remote recipient access not guaranteed.
